request.deadline: 12 months, beginning after closure of the existing contract
deliverables: Maintain the protobuf specification, including protocol compatibility, versioning, and documentation.
Maintain official SDKs, including dependency updates, performance improvements, and bug fixing.
Provide community support including issue triage, review of external contributions, ecosystem-feedback enhancements, and public communication.
Upgrade UTxO RPC compatibility with AI-driven development workflows through AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v for administration by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe
request.what: Fund UTxO RPC by TxPipe for Year 2 maintenance and enhancement, including part-time maintainer coverage, SDK/spec maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time UTxO RPC maintainer over 12 months, with a total treasury withdrawal of 540,750 ADA including a 15,750 ADA Intersect administration fee.
UTxO RPC is described as an open interface specification using Protocol Buffers and providing SDKs in Rust, Go, Node.js, .NET, Haskell, and Python for UTxO blockchain integration.
The proposal states that Amaru, Dingo, and the Haskell Cardano node have adopted UTxO RPC as a query interface, validating it as a standard across the ecosystem.
The project is said to maintain more than 10 repositories covering the core specification, language SDKs, documentation, and provider integrations under the Apache 2.0 open-source license.
The requested work covers protobuf specification maintenance, SDK maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation and integration resources.

The proposal states that it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal states that the withdrawal does not, at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713, either alone or in aggregate.
TxPipe is reported to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Intersect plans to administer funds through Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts with TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based sign-off thresholds, an external Oversight Committee, milestone-based disbursement controls, and a public dashboard.
The document references external sources for the project proposal, Hydra voting documentation and audited results, smart contract repository, and smart contract audit reports.

summary: The proposal seeks 540,750 ADA to fund one year of UTxO RPC maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect-administered treasury smart contracts, with stated technical scope, governance process references, NCL compliance, and oversight mechanisms, while several adoption and delivery-history claims remain proposer assertions within the anchor text.
